items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: There was a kid around there -- well, I call him a kid, he was older than I was, his name was Freddie Welch. He was a clarinet player.

ctx.x: Were there a lot of good musicians who we never heard of because they just dropped out?

Oh, yes. A whole lot of them. A whole lot of them. There was a kid around there -- well, I call him a kid, he was older than I was, his name was Freddie Welch. He was a clarinet player. And there was another fellow named Bob Fuller, a clarinet player. And I --
Bob Fuller, he made some records.
